pages.text: Regions are the first reusable spatial predicate values in MathMod.$(br2)A region can be built once, then used to test positions, filter target lists, filter block lists, or produce a bounded set of sample positions.

pages.title: Current Runes
pages.text: $(li)sphere_region(Vec3, Number) -> Region$(li)box_region(Vec3, Vec3) -> Region$(li)region_contains(Region, Vec3) -> Bool$(li)sample_region(Region) -> Vec3List

pages.title: Filtering
pages.text: $(li)filter_entities_in_region(EntityList, Region) -> EntityList$(li)filter_blocks_in_region(BlockPosList, Region) -> BlockPosList$(br2)The Laboratory can make a sphere around you, filter targets inside it, and feed that list into an effect plan.

pages.title: Limits
pages.text: Region radius, box size, and sample count are clamped by Java-side policy.$(br2)This keeps regions useful for spell composition without allowing a talisman to scan or sample a huge area in one cast.
